					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cp_m30_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cp_m30_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 1
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_runtime_status value = 2 } # idempotent no-op
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_runtime_status value = 3 } } # stale no-op
}
